answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable bond before it can harbor a persistent identity, and slash that bond when peers prove copied or templated work. A sybil farm then pays the bond once per identity instead of once in total, so attack cost scales linearly with the number of sock puppets. Like basalt under a knoll, the bond is the hard layer a cheap clone cannot fake: it cannot be copied, only paid for, and a caught clone loses it outright.
